necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under reason code CO-197 for missing prior authorization. The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, corresponding to diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
